scope: 16 Roxas-only chests. Local ordering is a checklist order, not Jiminy treasure numbering.

entries.name: Potion · Station of Serenity
entries.instructions: Open the chest after the first three Dusks.
entries.missability: Roxas-only chest; collect during the prologue. Sora cannot return to collect it. These chests are outside Jiminy’s numbered treasure list.
